versions.changelog:
Initial release of cargo-space-packer.

- Provides volume fitting with an 80% practical packing ceiling.
- Stacks cargo by density class and applies the "load pyramid" principle (heavy low and forward, soft goods on top/rear).
- Includes methods for tie-down count calculation per anchor style, with safety guidelines.
- Offers axle weight distribution recommendations and common loading mistakes to avoid.
- Generates ASCII load maps for organizing and securing cargo.
- Helps select the right truck size and check loading best practices.
